examples.scenario: Small parcel contains one pixel centre but touches four neighbouring cells
examples.reason: Default and all-touched sets differ; publish the stable interior result and edge uncertainty rather than silently selecting the larger set.

examples.scenario: Fractional coverage is 2% for the highest cell
examples.reason: Zonal maximum is not coverage-weighted, so a tiny overlap can control the raw maximum.

examples.scenario: Two adjacent parcel polygons both touch one edge cell
examples.reason: ALL_TOUCHED edge value can depend on feature order.

examples.scenario: Warp output has no destination NoData and an uncovered gap
examples.reason: Uncovered output must remain explicitly invalid.

examples.scenario: Target grid is TAP-aligned but shifted half a source pixel
examples.reason: Target alignment alone does not prove source-grid identity.

examples.scenario: Automatic overview was built with average resampling
examples.reason: Overview values can smooth parcel minima and maxima.

examples.scenario: Best OSTN/OSGM operation is unavailable because a grid is missing
examples.reason: A lower-quality approximate transformation cannot replace the required grid operation.

examples.scenario: Latitude and longitude are supplied in reversed authority order
examples.reason: Range, area-of-use and round-trip checks must detect the plausible but wrong coordinate.
